compositionLayers.label: Service catalog controls
notes: Composition controls bind to a family-qualified primitive before execution.
They are not standalone venue-admitted execution primitives.

compositionLayers.label: Product catalog controls
notes: Product terms select or compose product experiences over primitive families.
They inherit readiness from the primitive families they call.

compositionLayers.label: Future agentic orchestration terms
notes: Future agentic terms are strategy/orchestration vocabulary until IA promotes them.
They must not appear as direct execution tools without family and venue admission.
No-clear-venue terms are Phase 2 by default.
